title: Trang đăng nhập Wi-Fi không tải.
englishTitle: The Wi-Fi login page is not loading.
pronunciation: Trang dang nhap Wi-Fi khong tai
summary: For showing staff that the Wi-Fi sign-in page will not open on your phone.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Open the stuck screen before you ask. The problem is the sign-in page, not the password yet.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say the line and show the blank, spinning, or error screen. Let staff tap the network name if they offer.

phrases.vietnamese: Trang đăng nhập Wi-Fi không tải.
phrases.english: The Wi-Fi login page is not loading.
phrases.pronunciation: Trang dang nhap Wi-Fi khong tai

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Trang đăng nhập Wi-Fi means Wi-Fi login page; không tải means does not load.

breakdown.vietnamese: Trang đăng nhập Wi-Fi không tải.
breakdown.english: The Wi-Fi login page is not loading.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi password, common Wi-Fi, and SIM-card phrases cover the nearby connection setup path.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotels, cafes, coworking spaces, airports, buses, and shops with a captive Wi-Fi page.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If the page opens later, the next question is usually the password or verification code.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Battery, charger, charging-point, data-top-up, and eSIM phrases cover the phone problems that can look similar.
